title: A UPI or bank payment to MettleUp that is confirmed by mistake, bounced or paid back can never be undone or marked refunded
what: A payment the owner reports by UPI or bank transfer can only be waiting, confirmed or refused. Once MettleUp confirms it, the gym's plan and paid-until date move on and there is no way to take that back, mark it paid back, or show the owner that money was returned. A founding gym (Pro for life) can still send a payment that can never be confirmed; the money has arrived but the only choice is to refuse it, with no record that it was sent back. The refunds page promises money back for paying twice or paying too much.
expected: MettleUp can mark a confirmed or refused payment as paid back (with the date and how), and the gym's paid time is put back when a confirmed payment is reversed; a Pro-for-life gym is told it has nothing to pay before it sends money.
how_often: each wrong, bounced or refunded UPI or bank payment
fix_line: Add a paid-back state for UPI and bank payments that also undoes the paid time, and stop a Pro-for-life gym from sending a payment

title: An owner whose number already had a free trial gets a new gym with no free months and is never told
what: Once WhatsApp-checked sign-up is on, a gym made with a number that already started a free trial, or that already owns a gym, is made with its trial ending the moment it is created. The server says so in its answer, but the sign-up screen never reads it and the new-gym screen says nothing about it. The refunds page says every new gym gets 3 months free. With the plan limits switched on, that gym goes to basic mode after 7 days and read-only after 37, with no warning at sign-up.
expected: The sign-up screen tells the owner before and after creating the gym that this number has already used its free months and what it costs to carry on; the refunds page says one free trial per number.
who: owners opening a second gym or signing up again
how_often: every sign-up with a used number, once the number check is on
fix_line: Show the no-free-trial answer on sign-up and make the refunds page say one trial per number

title: Once a gym is read-only for not paying MettleUp, money the desk already took and printed a receipt for cannot be saved
what: When the plan limits are on and a gym has been unpaid for more than 37 days, the server refuses every desk record, receipts included. A receipt printed at a desk with no internet was promised never to be refused, but it now stays stuck on that device. Members who paid the gym also cannot be checked in, so an entry machine turns them away. The refunds page says the gym can still look and export, but not that cash already taken cannot be recorded.
expected: Receipts for money already taken (at least offline ones) and member check-ins are still saved in read-only, or the owner is warned clearly before read-only starts that the desk will stop recording fees and entries.
who: desks and members of a gym that stopped paying
how_often: every receipt and check-in after day 37 unpaid, once the switch is on
fix_line: Let receipts and check-ins through in read-only, or warn the owner plainly before it starts

items.reason: Server prices (Starter 999 / 9,990, Pro 1,499 / 14,990 a month / year) match the one price list; trial is 3 months as the refunds page says; receipts say not registered under GST, as the refunds page says. Faults: no paid-back state for UPI or bank payments (new 01); a used number silently gets no trial (new 02). The owner's typed amount is never compared with the price on the server: reuses FN-L5-panel-screens-2-02 (promise: refunds page part 3, paying more than the price is refunded). The renew request from the app shows no price by design (pay at the desk). Challenge and bring-a-friend free days only add days, no money.

UPI and bank payments here have no test mode: every one is checked by hand at MettleUp. The one function that turns any payment into a plan has no test-or-live mark, so a test-card payment from the online checkout becomes a real plan: reuses FN-L5-server-database-3-01. The member pay-me lookup hands out no amount (amounts live in the web server).

Waiting payments: at most 3, no expiry, refused ones can be sent again. Confirmed cannot be reversed or marked paid back (new 01). Expired plan: grace 7 days, basic 30, then read-only, same numbers on server and admin app; read-only refuses receipts for money already taken and check-ins (new 03). An offline receipt over what is owed is kept and the desk is told; the paid-too-much-no-refund-word fault already exists: FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-05. Paying during a trial or buying Starter while on Pro lost days here, but 0063 fixed both.

Price list is the same in server, admin app and plans list. The date HQ shows before Confirm was wrong for gyms in a trial in 0060, but 0064 now uses the same start as Confirm. The desk receipt limit uses price plus joining fee on server and admin app alike. Amount sent vs price is handled differently on the owner side and HQ: reuses FN-L5-panel-screens-2-02. A live check that 0060 to 0062 are applied could not be run (the database tool needs approval and was refused).
